title: Negative Proposition N / CH-A9: core-insufficiency case outputs
description: Phase B (prereg/v3-core-reduct-correction.md, tag prereg-p5-v3): checkers/core_insufficiency_counterexample.py's output. Runs the same generic core/reduct machinery (reduct.py) reduct_check.py uses against two registered cases -- Negative Proposition N's abstract fixture (prereg/fixtures/negative-proposition-n-counterexample.json) and CH-A9's constrained procurement-model variant (pair-test-grid.yaml's v3 section) -- so a negative finding is exactly as replayable and independently checked as CH-A8/CH-A10's positive ones.

supported.description: negative_proposition_n: always expected true (registered, machine-checked instance). ch_a9_constrained_procurement_variant: two-sided -- true iff core is insufficient AND minimum_reduct_cardinality > len(core_attributes), false (NOT SUPPORTED, printed as such) otherwise.

matches_registered_fixture_expectation.description: negative_proposition_n only: confirms this run's live computation matches the fixture's own `expected` block, registered before this checker existed. Not applicable to ch_a9_constrained_procurement_variant, which has no pre-registered expected outcome (CH-A9 is two-sided).
